# Databox

Connect your data from any tool and track it from any device. Build and share reports, monitor trends, and discover insights.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/databox/.

## Actions

- **Create Data Source**: Create a new data source in Databox.
- **Create Dataset**: Create a new dataset in Databox data source.
- **Delete Data Source**: Delete a data source by ID in Databox.
- **Delete Dataset**: Delete a dataset by ID in Databox.
- **Get Dataset Ingestion Status** (read-only): Check the status of a specific data ingestion for a dataset.
- **List Accounts** (read-only): Retrieve all Databox accounts accessible to the authenticated user.
- **Push Data to Dataset (V1)**: Push data points to a Databox dataset using the v1 API.
